description: Known-answer questions run against the vault to catch staleness and contradiction. Add entries to 'questions' to activate. 'must_include' = phrases the canonical answer should contain; 'stale_claims' = withdrawn/disproven phrases that must NOT reappear anywhere in the durable corpus except on a line carrying a negation/correction marker; 'canonical_paths' = files where the correct, current answer lives. Empty 'questions' passes trivially.

_example_question.question: your most important recurring question here
must_include: a phrase the correct current answer must contain
stale_claims: an old claim you have since withdrawn and never want to see again
